messages:
Samir K: Quick postmortem follow-up from the KV-cache OOM last night. Root cause looks like a slow-growing shard-local leak + fragmentation. I pulled heap snapshots and a few callouts below. Need owners for remediation items — profiling, GC tuning, soft limits, and canary rollout. Who can take which?

Maya L: I can take profiling + root-cause deep dive. Will run heap snapshots and live sampling across the two failing hosts. ETA EOD Thu. I'll paste commands + short repro.

Maya L: ```
# run heap profiler on node
ssh build-node-12
sudo /usr/local/bin/heaptrack --output /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).ht /opt/redwood/bin/kv_service --shard=17
```

Jonah P: I'll own GC/tuning and slab allocator knobs. Proposed quick flags to test in staging: `--kv-softlimit=0.72` and `--fragmentation-target=0.85`. Also enable earlier slab reclaim when `kv_frag_ratio > 0.9`. Canary after 2 perf cycles.

Priya R: I'll do canary plan + rollout steps. Suggest traffic ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic fallback if new OOM rate > 1/min or p95 latency regresses > 20%. I'll add smoke tests.

Derek S: We should add an alert for `kv_local_residency_growth > 5%/hour` and a daily leak-regression job (nightly heap-diff). I'll file a Jira and link it here.

incidents-bot: Created follow-up ticket INF-4123 and assigned to Samir K, Maya L, Jonah P, Priya R, Derek S. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4123

Samir K: Thanks. Quick asks: Maya, include a minimal repro + heap diff in the ticket. Jonah, schedule a patch rollout in staging tomorrow morning. Priya, draft runbook entries for detection + rollback. Derek, please add automated checks to perf harness.

Maya L: Putting repro + heap diffs in GCS: gs://redwood-debug/kv-leak/231901. Short diff summary: `+24MB/day` per hot shard, fragmentation jumps from ~70% -> 92% after steady-state. Attached sample stack traces in the ticket.

Jonah P: Noted. If fragmentation > 90% we should trigger slab reclaim sooner and throttle prefetch paths. I'll add `kv_frag_ratio` to the dashboards and alert thresholds.

Priya R: I'll own the canary test and rollback playbook. Draft plan in gist: https://gist.github.com/priya/abcd1234. Scheduling weekly check-ins until the fix is shipped.

Derek S: I'll wire up the nightly heap-diff job using existing perf harness (runs on `perf-harness-2`). ETA Tue next week. Adding owners+timeline to INF-4123 now.

Samir K: Great. Let's reconvene next Wed 10:00am PT for a short status sync. @Maya L @Jonah P @Priya R @Derek S :thumbsup:

Maya L: +1

Jonah P: :thumbsup:

Priya R: Added a preliminary checklist to INF-4123 (profiling artifacts, flags to try, canary metrics).

Derek S: FYI I'll also add a canary automation to toggle burst capacity to the dedicated pool if OOMs spike, so customer-facing traffic isn't impacted.

incidents-bot: INF-4123 updated: labels: postmortem, kv-leak, priority-high

Samir K: Thanks team — please update INF-4123 with any blockers. If anyone runs into noisy noise from fragment metrics, ping me directly and I'll help triage.

Maya L: Will do.

Jonah P: Copy.

Priya R: On it.

Derek S: Adding notes to the ops-runbook after staging verification.
